_network_note: Auth lives in ruyi itself: direct loopback clients are trusted, anything arriving via a reverse proxy / tunnel (X-Forwarded-For) or from LAN must present this bearer token. To share one ruyi across YOUR machines, set authToken and point remote agents at it. Never expose the port without authToken.

_llm_notes.protocol: 'anthropic' (Anthropic, Kimi coding endpoint, ...) or 'openai' (DeepSeek, OpenAI, Qwen, Moonshot, vLLM, Ollama, ...). For openai put the base up to /v1 or the host root, e.g. https://api.deepseek.com
_llm_notes.thinking: 'off' disables thinking (best effort, anthropic protocol verified), a number sets a budget, 'default' leaves it to the model. Recall works fine with thinking off and is much cheaper.
_llm_notes.steps: optional per-tier overrides, e.g. run recall (understand+rerank) on a cheap fast model: { "steps": { "recall": { "protocol": "openai", "baseUrl": "https://api.deepseek.com", "apiKey": "...", "model": "deepseek-chat", "thinking": "off" } } }
